# USAgentLeads developer documentation

V3 is available for Growth and Pro accounts; v2 remains available.
Base URL: https://www.usagentleads.com/api/v3
MCP: https://www.usagentleads.com/api/mcp
REST v3 and MCP: Growth and Pro.
Direct search/lookup: agents 1 credit, brokerages 2; already-owned records cost zero.
Free record-credit operations: count, preview, coverage, locations, account, usage, request recovery, job status, cancellation and repeat download.
Every API is rate-limited; account REST/MCP limit 60 requests/minute; Growth 10k and Pro 100k successful/in-flight requests per UTC month.
Billable POST: saved UUID Idempotency-Key header and max_credits body. Reuse both exactly on retries.
Contact fields are format-checked, not deliverability or consent guarantees.
See /quickstart, /plans-and-credits, /rate-limits, /migration-v3 and the audience-specific API references.
